report.title: Jarvis.ceo Task Architecture and Open-Source Integration

claims.claim: Jarvis is a voice dictation app that converts speech to text with features like filler removal and grammar correction.
Jarvis is fully offline with local Whisper or NVIDIA Parakeet support via Sherpa-ONNX.
Jarvis is open-source, local-capable, and free forever.
The AgentManager class initializes the UnifiedAgent with an LLM provider, supporting Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI.
The UnifiedAgent class processes queries using either function calling or text generation based on the provider's capabilities.
The AgentManager supports Ollama as the primary provider with fallback to Gemini and OpenAI.
The NativeReActAgent implements a thought-action-observation loop for task execution, using skills and tools.
The ReAct agent can respond with either a thought-action pair or a final answer, depending on the task.
The agent uses a loop guard to prevent infinite loops during task execution.
